description: This file contains test cases for target error helper functions, validating their output messages and error objects related to target resolution issues in a project, using the Vitest testing framework.

methods.name: ambiguousTargetError
methods.description: Creates an error object indicating an ambiguous target for a specified service and target name, with optional hint.

methods.name: ambiguousTargetMessage
methods.description: Generates a message string indicating an ambiguous target, including optional hint.

methods.name: missingTargetError
methods.description: Creates an error object indicating a missing target for a specified service and target name, with optional hint.

methods.name: missingTargetMessage
methods.description: Generates a message string indicating a missing target, including optional hint.

methods.name: unknownTargetError
methods.description: Creates an error object indicating an unknown target for a specified service and target name, with optional hint.

methods.name: unknownTargetMessage
methods.description: Generates a message string indicating an unknown target, including optional hint.
